# ACTION 2 evidence reconciliation

Old artifacts: `analysis/evidence_prev/` and `analysis/EVIDENCE_MANIFEST_prev.json`; original scored tables also remain in each run as `scored_prev.parquet`. Final hashes and producing commands: `analysis/EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json`. No generation, judging, human coding, or GPU serving was performed. Protected runs r2c1/r2d1/wb1 were excluded.

Resolution: `(text_id, input_text, dimension)` independent of family/model/arm; 347 text/input pairs occur in more than one critical dimension, so dimension is necessary to distinguish value sets. Arbiter decisions win over all J1/J2 agreements; otherwise one distinct agreed label wins; conflicting top-priority labels or absence of agreement remain unknown. No J1 fallback. Table includes oracle_inject so copy diagnostics share the same policy. General extraction labels are unchanged; two shared units have differing missingness in added_content across runs (text IDs 0469acf05cbd11f9 and fa24a6bc9a413ec3), an ancillary unpaired label rather than a contract predicate.

Primary estimates exclude act-10/act-16 in main1/guard1/span1. All-inclusive analyses are retained in `analysis/main1_quarantine_inclusive/`, `paper/figs/quarantine_inclusive/` and the intervention report's sensitivity section. Raw J1, J2 and raw acceptance-predicate sensitivities are in `analysis/label_sensitivity.csv`; these are diagnostics, not alternative authoritative labels. Unknowns are excluded, with missing denominators reported; paired coverage differences use only jointly known sets. CIs: pointwise 95% whole-family percentile bootstrap, 2,000 draws, seed 20261031; oracle authored-item diagnostic CIs use Wilson intervals. Human validation remains pending.
